title: Welcome to That's my Egg!
summary: Steal an egg, make it Home, and see what hatches. Meet the game we're building at Orchard Studios.
imageAlt: The current Labraduck guardian standing on the grass in Sunnyside Backyard
imageCaption: Labraduck in Sunnyside Backyard. Studio development capture, 7 November 2026.

sections.heading: The eggs belong to someone
paragraphs: That's my Egg! is a Roblox game about stealing eggs from guardians and getting them back to Home. The guardians have rather strong opinions about this.
Make it back with an egg, hatch it, and add the creature inside to your collection. Build up your garden and choose a pet to take along on the next run.

sections.heading: Further from Home
paragraphs: Your first trip takes you into Sunnyside Backyard. Further out are farms, woodland, reefs, an island, and mountain and sky regions still being developed.
Each region has its own creatures to discover. Some pets can be ridden; others help while following you. A useful companion is a good idea when your main plan is to run away.
sections.imageAlt: Hamsturtle on the current path beside Ripplewater Lake
sections.imageCaption: Hamsturtle at Ripplewater Lake. Studio development capture, 7 November 2026.

sections.heading: Follow the build
paragraphs: We'll post a development update every four days, with new creatures, changes to the world, and a look at what we're working on. The wiki has creature profiles and guides if you'd like a closer look.
Want to help test it? Join the early playtester list with your Roblox username, then look out for a friend request from OrchardStudios.
We're still building and testing the game. There's no release date yet, and Roblox access may be limited while development continues.

sections.imageCaption: Porcupython in Acorn Woods. Studio development capture, 7 November 2026.

title: The guardians got bigger. You didn't.
summary: New companions to help with the getaway, bigger guardians to get away from, and a better-looking world to run through. Here's what changed over 6 to 7 November.
imageAlt: The current Donkeyote creature model, with tall ears, a golden mane, and a bushy tail
imageCaption: Donkeyote, photographed from the current game model in Studio on 7 November 2026.

sections.heading: A few new faces
paragraphs: Donkeyote, Goosemoose, Kiwink, and Fennthorn have moved from artwork into the development build, with their eggs and animations. There are now a few more reasons to take an egg that isn't yours.
Donkeyote also brings Endurance when following you, helping your running stamina last longer. Handy company for a game in which a large part of the plan involves leaving.

sections.heading: Antlers at the lake
paragraphs: Goosemoose belongs at Ripplewater Lake. Broad wings, a long neck, and a substantial set of antlers make it fairly easy to spot.
As a following pet, Goosemoose brings Tide rider to help you swim faster. If your route home involves water, that's a useful friend to have along.
sections.imageAlt: The current Goosemoose model with broad wings, a long neck, and branching antlers
sections.imageCaption: Goosemoose's current game model. Studio development photo, 7 November 2026.

sections.heading: A little help getting away
paragraphs: Kiwink joins the creatures of Acorn Woods. Its long bill is good for nosing through leaf litter; its Fleet foot benefit helps you run faster while it follows you.
You can only take one active companion at a time, so choose between help with stamina, swimming, running, or another pet's benefit before heading out. Looking adorable is a bonus.
sections.imageAlt: The current brown Kiwink model with a long bill, small wings, and a scaled tail
sections.imageCaption: Kiwink's current game model. Studio development photo, 7 November 2026.

sections.heading: About those guardians
paragraphs: All 14 biome guardians are now 25% bigger. Labraduck, Mooroo, Dandylion, and Dragorilla have refreshed models as well.
The eggs haven't got any less tempting. The thing watching them has simply become harder to ignore.

sections.heading: Nicer scenery for your escape
paragraphs: Acorn Woods has new leaf and bark textures across its trees, and we fixed a small gap at the tip of the pine. Do try to appreciate the woodland while sprinting through it.
The Jungle's ocean entrance has more connected sand and water along the coast. A little space has moved from Forest to Jungle, too, without making the overall journey longer.
Over at Lost World, a partly buried Triceratops skeleton now marks the beach landing. It's scenery. If it starts chasing you, something has gone very wrong.

sections.heading: Know what you are hatching
paragraphs: Creature information now includes a separate Animal combination field, so you can see the two animals behind each design alongside the species description.
These are changes to our development build. Gameplay testing and polish are still ahead.
